title: Unauthorized Setpoint Change Detected on RTUs at RS-21 and RS-22

lines.msg: ROCLINK session initiated from CVG-OT-JMP01 (203.0.113.14) using account 'halden-support' (MFA verified)
ROCLINK command received: 'Set PC-21-SP to 13 in. w.c.'
ROCLINK command received: 'Set PC-22-SP to 13 in. w.c.'
No operator approval record found for configuration change under CVG-CRM-2025 Section 6.3
Audit trail for session 'CR-20270113-164215-0032' missing from CVG-SCADA01 and CVG-OT-JMP01
ROCLINK session terminated abnormally; no logout event recorded
RTU ROC800 at RS-21 and RS-22 applied new setpoint: PC-21-SP = 13 in. w.c., PC-22-SP = 13 in. w.c.
Configuration change confirmed on field RTUs. No local HMI or engineering console override detected.
System-wide integrity check failed: setpoint change not authorized, not logged, not reviewed.
Alert generated by CVG-ENG01 audit monitor: Unauthorized configuration change to PC-21-SP and PC-22-SP detected.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the cyber-physical breach. The GCM must immediately validate the setpoint change and initiate EOP 6.3. Watch for hesitation to act on technical evidence from the engineering workstation.
